title: melica scabrosa f. puberula
intro: Melica scabrosa f. puberula, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species in the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, making it effective in loosening and removing mucus from the lungs. Bioactive constituents present in Melica scabrosa f. puberula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions.
